elements.description: Identity equation: Y/N = Y/E × E/L × L/A × A/N. Where: Y = Total value added; N = Population; E = Employment; L = Labor force; A = Working age population (15-64 years old).
Equation: y = w × e × p × a. Where: y = Value added per capita; w = Value added per worker; e = Employment rate; p = Participation rate; a = Working age population / total population.
Decomposition equation: Δy = Δy^w + Δy^e + Δy^p + Δy^a, where each Δ term is the marginal contribution of w, e, p, and a respectively to Δy, holding other variables constant.

Shapley decomposition formula: Δy^w(t0,t1) = α^w(s,m) + [(w11 e10 p10 a10) - (w10 e10 p10 a10) - (w11 e11 p11 a11) - (w10 e11 p11 a11)] + (w11 e11 p10 a10) - (w10 e11 p10 a10) - (w11 e10 p11 a10) - (w10 e10 p11 a10) + (w11 e10 p11 a10) - (w10 e10 p10 a11) - (w11 e11 p11 a10) - (w10 e10 p11 a10) + (w11 e11 p10 a11) - (w10 e11 p10 a11) - (w11 e11 p11 a11) - (w10 e10 p11 a11). Terms are printed in four aligned rows across four columns, with the first term in the first row written as + [(w11 e10 p10 a10) ... ] bracketed as shown on the page.
